name: BREADTH AT LEG OPEN — is the run broad?
registered_by: operator asked: 'pull all the data from ibkr to be able to tell me if a run is broad or not. and backtest it well to see if true.'
hypothesis: An MNQ leg whose OPENING 8 MINUTES are accompanied by >70% of the ten NDX megacaps moving the same way runs FURTHER and FASTER than one where <=40% do.

frozen_definition.leg: the desk's standing definition — opens on 1xATR in 8 min, dies on 3xATR back from the extreme (scripts/leg_survival.py). NOT to be re-derived here.
frozen_definition.window: +8 minutes from leg open — the SAME bars the leg detector needs, so both are known at the same instant
frozen_definition.breadth: share of names whose 5-min close moved the leg's way across that window; a name is skipped if its last print is over 15 min stale
frozen_definition.hours: US cash only, 13:30-20:00Z — outside them the constituents are SHUT and a reading would be manufactured from a stale close

in_sample_result_2026_08_19_to_09_18.confound_tested: survives WITHIN every duration band (+12.8pt short, +7.0 mid, +20.2 long) and on points-per-minute, which is size-neutral. So it is not merely a proxy for a bigger opening push — which mattered, because MNQ IS those stocks.

what_was_REFUTED_and_must_not_be_re-run: Breadth measured over the 15 minutes BEFORE the leg opens carries NO signal: broad came in 3.5pt WORSE than narrow with fully overlapping CIs (n=354). Prior participation tells you nothing. Only the leg's OWN opening move does.
the_search_being_charged: THREE windows were tried (-15, +5, +8) and the best two are reported. That is a search, and this desk charges for searches. The in-sample numbers above are therefore NOT the expected forward effect — they are an upper bound on it.

forward_test.verdict_rule: BROAD must beat NARROW on points-per-minute with non-overlapping day-clustered 95% CIs. Median travel is secondary. If they are indistinguishable the finding is REFUTED even if both are positive.
do_not: do NOT tune the 0.40/0.70 bands — moving them restarts the count at zero
do NOT add or drop names from the ten
do NOT change the +8 window; anything longer leaks the outcome into the predictor
do NOT read the interim before 120 legs — n<120 is not evidence by construction
do NOT wire it to any gate, switch or order path; it is a READING on the dashboard and nothing else

known_limits: applies to roughly 37% of his entries — the rest happen while the constituents are shut
30 days in sample, one market regime
the ten names are a proxy for the index's top weights, not the true float-cap weighting
